Payments is the ledger of money actually moving, both directions.
AP is what went out to your subs and suppliers.
AR is what came in from your customers.
Each row carries the project, the date, the amount, how it was paid and a check number if you have one.
Filter by project, by contractor, by supplier, by status or by date, and download the lot as a CSV for your bookkeeper.
Record a payment here or from inside the project — either way it lands in one place.
